interpretation: Descriptive resource example, not diagnostic validation. Subjects and physical libraries are unconfirmed. Shared reads and protocol/batch can influence associations.
selection: Genes were specified before inspecting effects. Promoters are the first source IDs in lexical order, not outcome-selected or asserted major promoters.

channel.interpretation: featureCounts paired fragment assignment with -B -C, -s 0. CPM/TPM denominators use ALL featureCounts genes before protein-coding/lncRNA view selection; not subset-renormalized and not UMI counts.
Source active threshold TPM>=1; largest active usage is major, other active usage minor; inactive=1 when no active promoter. Preserve source tie ordering.

summary_en: Source-declared gene links connect expression, coverage and promoter gene usage in one study.
